headline: Emerging Currencies Hold Near Record High as Carry Trades Revive
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Currencies from the developing world hovered near record highs on Thursday, benefiting from renewed interest in carry trades, though gains were capped by the absence of concrete new developments in US-Iran peace talks.
